g.text: the two bands overlap at the corner (a w × w
square); mitre them to one point H. DEFAULT.
each band pokes across the other edge into the
polygon; mitre them: exact while it is thick.
c tight corner, one edge banded
the cap crosses the plain edge into the polygon;
stop the band at the crossing. DEFAULT.
d tight corner, a sliver behind it
a band reaches through the sliver past its far
edge; the mitre removes that spill. OPTIONAL.
e a pinch: the boundary meets itself
the lobe behind the plain edge tapers to 0 at
the vertex; clip (red dashes) cuts ink. GUARDED.
f an edge shorter than w, reflex corner
the bands reach past each other's ends: no
exact fix. Drop that band (lossy). OPTIONAL.
g convex corner: keep the notch
option 7 returns to the tip between the bands; a
bevel (red) would paint over T. DECLINED.
h a free end: follow the neighbour
the perpendicular corner spills past Q; put it
on Q's own edge b→q. No q known: perpendicular.
samples whose filled state the fix changes
w = 16 units here, 1 px in the renderer (d and e zoomed). Outlines are bench/pathshape.js's bandLoop()
output; each status line samples both paths' nonzero winding on a 0.5-unit lattice, 577 600 samples a panel.
